BL-0.1.4-009-S1.title: Query Size Estimation Contract
BL-0.1.4-009-S1.description: Define a standard contract for estimating Mongo query size including parameters (document_count, avg_doc_size, projected_response_size) and thresholds aligned with GPTReader limits (100-doc cap, 500KB response cap).

BL-0.1.4-009-S2.title: Core Query Size Estimation Logic
BL-0.1.4-009-S2.description: Implement backend logic to estimate Mongo query result size prior to execution using document count limits, sampling (e.g., small result probe), and heuristic avg document size; enforce guardrails aligned to 100-doc and 500KB caps.

BL-0.1.4-009-S3.title: Pre-Execution Query Guard Integration
BL-0.1.4-009-S3.description: Integrate size estimation into GPTReader query execution path to block, truncate, or paginate queries exceeding thresholds; return structured responses indicating partial data or limit enforcement.

BL-0.1.4-009-S4.title: Query Size Estimation Tests
BL-0.1.4-009-S4.description: Develop unit and integration tests validating size estimation accuracy, enforcement of 100-document and 500KB limits, and correct handling of oversized query scenarios.

BL-0.1.4-009-S5.title: Audit Logging for Query Size Enforcement
BL-0.1.4-009-S5.description: Implement logging of estimated query sizes, blocked/truncated/paginated queries, and enforcement outcomes including metadata (query shape, estimated size, actual size if executed, decision path).
